en: A black and white vintage postcard featuring a woman in late 19th or early 20th-century attire, standing in front of a wall covered in ivy. She is holding a cane or parasol and is accompanied by a large dog (possibly a Saint Bernard). The woman is wearing a decorative hat and an ornate dress. The text at the bottom identifies her as 'Madame Delait' and mentions she is on a walk with her dog.
